In the मन्त्र literature,the affix णिवन् comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' when in composition the word अव्।

Terms: णिवन्

The affix घञ् is optionally used after the root ग्रह् 'to seize' when the word अव is in composition, the sense being 'witholding the rain'.

Terms: घञ्

The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. तॄ 'to cross' 2. स्तॄ 'to spread, to cover', when the उपसर्ग अव is in composition with them and when the word so formed is an appellative related to the verb either as an instrument or as a location.

Terms: घञ्

The affix क comes after अवि without change of sense.

Terms: क
